Rescuing everyone except the Syaphru school adult gives the lowest cost I found: **146**. I compared the realistic options by hand, as shown below.

**Reasoning**
- **Injured at Nilkantha:** a 36-minute round trip rescues all 4 and avoids a 320 penalty.
- **Adults at Bidur:** a 54-minute round trip rescues all 4 and avoids an 80 penalty.
- **Adults at Nilkantha:** a separate 36-minute round trip avoids a 40 penalty, so it saves 4.
- **Adult at Syaphru:** a 36-minute round trip would only avoid a 20 penalty, so deferring is cheaper. This trip can't be combined with the others because Syaphru connects to the other locations only through the shelter.
- **Benighat and Jwalamukhi:** nobody is waiting at either location, so neither needs a visit.

**Alternatives for the 4 injured and 6 adults at Nilkantha and Bidur**

The Syaphru deferral (20) is included in every total.

| Option | Driving | Penalties | Total |
|---|---|---|---|
| Three separate trips, rescuing all 10 | 126 | 20 | **146** |
| Injured trip and Bidur trip, deferring 2 Nilkantha adults | 90 | 60 | 150 |
| Injured trip and Bidur–Nilkantha loop, deferring 2 Bidur adults | 100 | 60 | 160 |
| Injured trip and second Nilkantha trip, deferring 4 Bidur adults | 72 | 100 | 172 |

Rescuing all 10 takes at least 3 trips with 4 seats. Using the 64-minute Bidur–Nilkantha loop as one of those trips costs at least 136 in driving, compared with 126 for separate trips.
